name: BROKEN TOP CLUB MAINTENANCE
address: 367 SW MT WASHINGTON DR, BEND, OR 97702

fr.elements: Open Green Space; Landscaped Area; Detached Structure; Detached Structure; Vehicle Parking Area; Walkway; Dense Vegetation; Water Feature; Perimeter Fencing
fr.considerations: Dense Vegetation; Limited Side Access; Single Access Point; Multiple Structures
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the single driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions on the road.
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entry that is visible at night and in low-visibility conditions.
• Keep a gate or pathway on at least one side of the property unlocked and clear to allow responders to reach the rear without passing through the main structure.
• Trim dense vegetation along the sides of the property to create a walking path wide enough for responders carrying equipment.
• Cut back any dense vegetation that overhangs or narrows the path between the detached structures and the main building.
• Mark the locations of both detached structures on any posted property map or address placard so responders arriving for the first time can quickly account for all buildings.
• Keep the area around the water feature clear of dense vegetation so responders can identify and avoid it quickly during low-light or high-stress operations.
• Post a simple site map near the main entrance showing the location of all structures, the water feature, and any side access points.
• Clear a staging area in the vehicle parking zone wide enough for at least one emergency vehicle to park without blocking the single access point.
• Trim vegetation along the perimeter fence line so responders can move around the inside of the fence without obstruction.

wildfire.conditions: Open Green Space; Tree Cluster; Tree Cluster; Scattered Trees; Brush Area; Vegetation Near Structure; Grass Cover; Mixed Vegetation; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Scattered Shrubs; Vegetation Along Driveway; Open Terrain
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim back shrubs and vegetation that are growing directly against or touching the structure.
• Thin trees within the clusters nearest to the structure to create more open space between individual trees.
• Remove or cut back brush in the brush area closest to the structure.
• Mow or cut grass cover around the structure and outbuildings to keep it short.
• Trim overhanging branches and cut back shrubs along the driveway to keep the travel lane clear.
• Separate scattered shrubs from one another where they connect or nearly touch near the structure.
• Thin or trim the mixed vegetation area where it grows close to any structure or outbuilding.
• Keep the open terrain areas clear of accumulating dead grass or debris that could carry fire toward the structure.
• Remove dead material from within scattered tree groupings near the structure.
